planets.name: TOI-1273 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1273 with a 4.63-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1273 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1273. Its orbit and size follow Serrano Bell et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
